summary: CPW's SWA page says only 'Camping allowed in designated areas', a license or SWA pass for everyone 16+, a boat ramp and a Feb 15 - Jul 15 closure north of the buoy line; it does not describe the Mosca campground (site count, electric, season, booking), and cpwshop has no listing. Nothing changed; the manual fees row was left alone.
flags: No official source describes the campground any more: the CPW SWA page (the stored website) mentions camping only as 'E. Camping allowed in designated areas.' and shows a 'Mosca Campground' photo. The 51 sites, 50-amp electric, no water/sewer, no showers and the Apr-Oct season rest on Campendium/aggregator reports (electric at every site, vault toilets, no water, dump station, 'Open Seasonally Late May - October 1st'), none from CPW. The derived fields (hookups, sites, facilities, season, booking) stay unconfirmed. A call to the CPW Monte Vista/Alamosa office (719-587-6900, the stored phone) is the only way to confirm.

Lake water: the note says 'The lake itself is currently dry', but both Esri World_Imagery and the NAIP layer show San Luis Lake holding water (NAIP: full to the shoreline, ~150-300 m east of the campground loops; Esri: lower, with a wide exposed flat). Neither image is dated in the tile service, so the 'currently dry' line is unconfirmed either way; stored lakeview is consistent with both images. Fishing Opportunities on the SWA page lists 'Coldwater Lake' and Boating is an activity, which suggests water.
Pin 37.6770,-105.7330 is at the east end of the campground road beside the boat-ramp/day-use spur, within ~50-350 m of the loops. OK.
